item.title: Remote Control Your Windows PC
item.description: Lately, when my local PC is training models, it completely locks me out of doing other work. Once set up, I can run my training there and keep doing my own thing on my main machine. item.title: Changing Fonts in VS Code
item.description: Intro Recently, while browsing online, I found a font I quite liked, so I looked up how to change it. Turns out, it wasn’t as impressive in practice. Method One In the bottom left, hit Manage -> Settings (or use CTRL+,). Once in settings, find Editor: Font Family. Just change the default Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace to the font you want. Method Two Hit Ctrl + Shift + P -> type settings.json -> select Preferences: Open Settings (JSON) to open the settings.json file. …

item.description: Let’s Get Started First off, after you’ve got VS Code and Python installed and environment variables all set: Fire up VS Code, head over to the Extensions view, search for ‘Python’, and install it.
